# **Purpose**

The purpose of this board is to control the brushless motors on the rover. A brushless motor uses magnets that are quickly turned on and off to spin the motor, so it is much more complicated than a brushed motor. It is more efficient, however. This board is on a longer timeline due to this complexity. The goal is to have a dev board in the first semester and to have a finished board by the end of the school year.

# **Interfaces**

The main interface is with Mobility and Robotic Arm (RA). It will be mounted by the wheels and on the arm. The main design consideration is with Mobility, as there is less room in the E-Case then on the arm. 

2025 Mobility (E-Case subject to change)

The E-Case is where the axle of the wheel is. It also has the gear box for the wheel.
